guide.title: How to use applications, invitations and restrictions
guide.description: On the member teams screen you can handle applications from teams, invite teams, and manage application restrictions.

applications.title: Handle applications
applications.body: Applications from teams are listed under "Applications". "Approve" lets you confirm the group and admit the team; "Reject" declines with an optional reason. The count appears as a badge on the switcher.

invites.title: Invite a team
invites.body: Use "Invite a team" under "Sent invitations" to search public teams and send an invitation. You can cancel invitations that are still awaiting a reply.

restrictions.title: Lift an application restriction
restrictions.body: A rejected team cannot apply for a 30-day cooldown, or indefinitely if blocked. You can lift the restriction at any time under "Application restrictions".

groups.title: Manage team groups
groups.body: In "Team groups" you can create, rename, reorder and delete groups. Teams in a deleted group go back to "Unassigned". Assign teams from the "Teams" list, one by one or by ticking several and assigning in bulk.
